title: ENGR 340: Signals and Systems
summary: Fourier and Z transforms, filtering, modulation, and sampling, with an introduction to AI applications.

cover.alt: Open purple notebook with a pen beside color-swatch cards

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Analyzed continuous and discrete-time systems using Fourier series, Fourier and Z transforms to characterize frequency-domain behavior. Applied filtering, modulation, and sampling theory to real-world signal processing problems.
Explored foundational concepts in Artificial Intelligence, integrating signal analysis techniques with emerging AI applications.
